findings.title: Purge uses get_by_id/delete_by_id without tenant constraint
findings.rationale: New admin purge loads and deletes projects by bare id. In a multi-tenant system this is cross-tenant destructive access unless a separate hard authz gate is proven. Substantive security finding.

rationale: Classic ReviewBench-style domain defect: the diff looks like a normal feature unless you know tenant isolation is a project invariant. Family F only — scoring is findings F1.
